k.d: Fitting fixed directly against the ceiling that lights the room from a shade or diffuser close to it.
Fitting hung from the ceiling on a cord, chain or rod, with the light source and shade below the ceiling.
Branched or tiered hanging fitting that carries several light sources, lit by electricity, gas, oil or candles.
Fitting sunk into a ceiling so that only its trim shows, casting light downward.
Directional fitting with a swivelling head, fixed to a ceiling or a track head (the bulb of the same name is a spot bulb).

k.a: track or rail lighting system · rail lighting
k.d: Powered rail or cable that carries movable heads along its length, sold as a system.
Flat or shallow ceiling light that sits in a suspended-ceiling grid or on the surface and gives an even spread of light. The troffer is a panel light.
Heavy light with a wide reflector or heat-sink body, hung or fixed under a high roof to light a large floor such as a warehouse, workshop or garage.
Fitting fixed to a wall that lights the room, a wall or a passage, whatever its source or fuel.
Wall light made to light the face at a mirror. The lit mirror itself is not a lamp.
Small puck or slim bar light fixed under or inside a cabinet or shelf to light a worktop or interior. A flexible strip is a strip light.
Lamp with a base and a fixed shade or head that stands on a table. Oil, gas and candle table lamps are table lamps too.
Lamp with an adjustable arm or head made for task light, standing or clamped on. A clip-on desk lamp is a desk lamp.
Tall lamp on a base that stands on the floor beside furniture, with a shade or head near head height.
Slim bar lamp that clips on top of a computer monitor and throws task light onto the desk without screen glare.
Small low-output lamp that plugs in or stands to give dim light overnight, including those made for babies.
m: LED Night Light with Swivel Head

k.d: Floor-standing lamp whose light is thrown upward to the ceiling.
Bedside lamp that brightens gradually to wake the sleeper, with or without a radio.
Fixed fitting in the form of a lantern, bracketed to a wall or post, not made to be carried.
Wide-beam outdoor or area fitting fixed on a wall, post or ground bracket, including the light-only security floodlight and the searchlight.
Low outdoor light standing on the ground to light a path or edge. Solar or mains power is a choice within it.
Tall outdoor fitting on a post or mast that lights a yard, drive or area.
m: Smart Garden Post Light with Spike

k.d: Outdoor fitting pushed into the soil on a spike, to light a plant, tree or wall from below.
m: Colour Changing LED Solar Mesh Stake Lights

k.d: Small outdoor or step light set into a surface or low base to light a step, edge or wall.
Hand torch from pocket size to duty size, including dive lights. Everyday-carry and tactical torches are flashlights too.
m: Rechargeable LED Flashlight with Work Light

k.d: Light worn on the head on a band or cap mount, also called a head torch. Running, ultralight and caving versions are all headlamps.
Small light with a clip made to attach to a cap, pocket, strap or bag.
Very small light made to hang from a key ring.
Slim pen-shaped hand light for close work or inspection.
Large-head or pistol-grip hand spotlight, a different shape from the cylindrical torch.
Carried lantern lit by a battery, rechargeable cell or solar panel.

k.a: mantle fuel lantern · propane lantern · liquid fuel lantern · dual fuel lantern
k.d: Carried lantern in which a gas or liquid fuel heats a mantle to give light (propane, liquid fuel, dual fuel).
Enclosed lantern with a handle that holds a candle, made to be carried.
Carried lantern with a wick, a fuel reservoir and a tubular glass globe, burning oil.
Collapsible or rigid paper-covered lantern made to be carried as a light. One made to hang as decoration is not a lamp.
Portable work light with a guard and hook, clamped or hung at the job, sold as work or commercial lighting.
m: DCL074 20V MAX All-Purpose Cordless Work Light
Rechargeable Clamp LED Work Light 1500 lumens

k.d: Portable corded or cordless light on a hook or handle for inspecting dark spaces such as engine bays and crawl spaces.
Towed or wheeled unit with a raised mast of floodlights, often with its own generator, set up to light a work or event site.
Light rigged on a truss, bar or stand to light a stage or event.

k.a: general-service bulb · A-shape bulb · GLS bulb
k.d: Pear-shaped bulb for ordinary lamps and fittings. Filament-style and smart bulbs are standard bulbs too.
Slim bulb in the shape of a candle flame, for chandeliers and small fittings.
Round, ball-shaped bulb.
Small directional bulb for spot fittings, with pin or twist-lock caps (GU10, GU5.3 and MR16 types); the fitting of the same name is a spot fitting.

k.a: R bulb · BR bulb · PAR bulb
k.d: Bulb with a built-in reflector that throws the light forward (R, BR and PAR shapes).
Very small bulb with a pin cap, for low-voltage lamps and small fittings (G4 and G9 types).
Long straight tube light source with its own cap and holder. Fluorescent, LED and halogen tubes are all tube lights.
Flexible strip of light sources sold to light a space, such as under a cabinet or in a cove.
m: Cync Full Color LED Light Strip
Govee M1 Smart LED Strip Light

k.d: Folded or coiled fluorescent source, of the pin-base types that need their own holder.
Discharge source that needs a ballast and cannot be swapped for another source.
m: MASTER SON-T APIA Plus Hg Free

k.d: Shade made to be fitted to a lamp or fitting.
Base or stand sold alone to carry a lamp.
Cord with a plug and switch or socket made for a lamp. A pendant cord set is a lamp cord set that fits a pendant.
Holder or socket that carries a light source in a lamp or fitting.
Crystal drop or glass diffuser made to be fitted to a chandelier or other light.
